query:
SELECT (
            (SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM net_devices nd
                JOIN net_device_creds ndc ON ndc.device_id = nd.id AND ndc.cred_id = $3
                WHERE nd.id = $2 AND nd.account_id = $1
            ))
            OR account_role_exists($1, 'network_manager'::app_role)
        ) AS "allowed!: bool"
